asks.ask: Each repo keeps its agent settings in one YAML file in its Dokima folder.
The file lists subscriptions, each naming its agent and the secret holding its key.
The file gives the planner, the worker and the reviewer each a subscription and a model.
A role may name any model its agent takes; Dokima keeps no list of allowed models.
Each run starts the agent of its role's subscription, with the model the file names.
With no settings file, every run starts Claude Code with today's model, as now.
A role the file leaves out starts Claude Code with today's model, as now.
A role naming an unknown subscription or agent stops before any agent starts, and the run names the bad name.
Claude Code runs behind the one agent interface with the same command, record and stats as today.
A model always runs in its own vendor's agent, never inside another vendor's agent.
Moving a role to another subscription takes one edit: that role's lines in the file.
When a role's agent fails, the run fails; no other subscription takes over.
Later it may expand into other settings.
